# Connected Mate

> Connected Mate is a French ecosystem founded in 2018 by Alexandre Cormeraie and PPC, offering Coding Mate training (Vibe Designing for designers), AI and innovation keynotes, a podcast with 100+ episodes, privacy-first iOS and macOS apps (Better Dictate, Pock, Notetaker AI, Dys Keyboard), and white-label AI consulting. Connected Mate SAS is based in Paris (74 avenue du General Leclerc, 75014).

Important facts at a glance:

- Legal entity: Connected Mate SAS, Paris, France
- Founders: Alexandre Cormeraie (co-founder, AI keynote speaker) and PPC (co-founder)
- Founded: 2018
- Contact: alex.connectedmate@gmail.com / WhatsApp @alexandre.cormeraie
- Languages: French, English
- Clients include: INSEAD, CEDEP, CFAO, Nexus Automotive International, Tech Rocks, AEF info

## Coding Mate training

- [Vibe Designing (FR)](https://connectedmate.com/formations.html): become a Vibe Designer; four days recommended, individual or group, customizable, quotation on request.
- [Vibe Designing (EN)](https://connectedmate.com/en/formations.html): English programme.
- Outcomes: choose AI models and tools, direct agents with Spec Drive, create a coded SaaS web interface and a mobile app (iOS or Android depending on workstation), iterate using Annotate Kit, prepare code for developer integration and production review.
- Trainer: Alexandre Cormeraie, AI and Innovation lead at TGV. Training offered by Coding Mate; no employer endorsement implied.
- Pre-course call prepares workstation, AI subscriptions and moodboard. Content updated for each session.
- [Discuss a session](https://connectedmate.com/contact.html?intent=formation)
- [Offer this training to your clients](https://connectedmate.com/contact.html?intent=partenaire)

## Applications

- [Better Dictate (FR)](https://connectedmate.com/better-dictate.html): on-device voice dictation for macOS, powered by Whisper, 100% offline
- [Better Dictate (EN)](https://connectedmate.com/en/better-dictate.html): English product page
- [Notetaker AI (FR)](https://connectedmate.com/notetaker-ai.html): meeting transcription and note-taking assistant for iOS
- [Notetaker AI (EN)](https://connectedmate.com/en/notetaker-ai.html): English product page
- [Pock (FR)](https://connectedmate.com/pock.html): Touch Bar customization for MacBook Pro
- [Pock (EN)](https://connectedmate.com/en/pock.html): English product page
- [Dys Keyboard (FR)](https://connectedmate.com/dys-keyboard.html): the iOS keyboard everyone should have had from day one. Bigger keys, color-coded zones that guide the eye and ease the memory. Built for dyslexia, dysorthographia, dyspraxia, and great for kids, teens, adults and seniors alike. On-device only
- [Dys Keyboard (EN)](https://connectedmate.com/en/dys-keyboard.html): English product page
